default-open.description: The initial open state of the drawer.

modal.description: Whether to prevent pointer interaction outside the element and hide all content below it.

swipe-direction.description: The direction in which the drawer can be swiped.

snap-points.description:
The snap points of the drawer.
Array of numbers or strings representing the snap points.

snap-to-sequential-points.description: Whether the drawer should snap to sequential points when swiping.

close-threshold.description: The threshold distance for dismissing the drawer.

swipe-velocity-threshold.description: The threshold velocity (in pixels/s) for closing the drawer.

close-on-escape.description: Whether to close the drawer when the escape key is pressed.

close-on-interact-outside.description: Whether to close the drawer when the outside is clicked.

trap-focus.description: Whether to trap focus inside the sheet when it's opened.

prevent-scroll.description: Whether to prevent scrolling behind the sheet when it's opened

restore-focus.description: Whether to restore focus to the element that had focus before the sheet was opened.

prevent-drag-on-scroll.description:
Whether to prevent dragging on scrollable elements.
When enabled, the sheet will not start dragging if the user is interacting with a scrollable element.

skip-animation-on-mount.description: Whether to allow the initial presence animation.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

openchange.description: Fired when the open state changes.

snappointchange.description: Fired when the snap point changes.

triggervaluechange.description: Callback when the active trigger value changes.

escapekeydown.description: Fired when the escape key is pressed

requestdismiss.description: Fired when this layer is closed due to a parent layer being closed

pointerdownoutside.description: Fired when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

focusoutside.description: Fired when the focus is moved outside the component

interactoutside.description: Fired when an interaction happens outside the component

initialFocusEl.description:
Element to receive focus when the sheet is opened.
Return `false` to skip moving focus, or `null` to use the default.

finalFocusEl.description: Element to receive focus when the sheet is closed.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the drawer. Useful for composition.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

for.description: The id of the root this part belongs to, when it is not a descendant.

state.description: The part's state from its machine, such as an item's `selected` and `highlighted`. `undefined` until it connects.
